candidates.name: Chronic Thromboembolic Pulmonary Hypertension
support_spans: moderate tricuspid regurgitation and possible pulmonary hypertension
dilation of the main pulmonary artery, which was filled with a hypodense mass containing areas of calcification adjacent to both right and left pulmonary arteries
The plasma D-dimer level was 1.9 μg/mL (normal ≤ 1.0 μg/mL)
candidates.why: The combination of exertional dyspnea, palpitations, tricuspid regurgitation, and pulmonary hypertension along with the findings of a hypodense mass in the pulmonary arteries and elevated D-dimer levels points towards Chronic Thromboembolic Pulmonary Hypertension.
